description.value: Valley Bakery has been a Burnaby institution since 1957, producing European-style baked goods including artisanal breads, buttercream pastries, wedding cakes, and savoury meat pies. Located on Hastings Street, it is one of the Lower Mainland's longest-running independent bakeries with over six decades of community presence. A touring cyclist could stop here for fresh-baked bread and savoury meat pies as a food resupply.
